title: The Radiators of Room 214
author: Oscar Hartwell
blurb: Juniper Halloran, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
